summary: An online e-commerce mentor persuaded the user to pay 6000 dollars in Bitcoin for a Shopify storefront setup and marketing services then stopped communicating without delivering the services. The mentor subsequently requested another 1100 dollars for advertising to recover the initial investment.
user_mistake: paid an online mentor upfront in Bitcoin for promised e-commerce services
prevention: Require verifiable service delivery milestones before sending irreversible crypto payments / Do not send additional funds to recover an earlier payment
